section.title: org.osgi.service.dal.functions
section.para: Device Abstraction Layer Functions Package 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.dal.functions; version="[1.0,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.dal.functions; version="[1.0,1.1)"}

listitem.para: Alarm - {@code Alarm} function provides alarm sensor support.
BooleanControl - {@code BooleanControl} function provides a boolean control support.
BooleanSensor - {@code BooleanSensor} function provides boolean sensor monitoring.
Keypad - {@code Keypad} function provides support for keypad control.
Meter - {@code Meter} function can measure metering information.
MultiLevelControl - {@code MultiLevelControl} function provides multi-level control support.
MultiLevelSensor - {@code MultiLevelSensor} function provides multi-level sensor monitoring.
Types - Shares common constants for all functions defined in this package.
WakeUp - {@code WakeUp} function provides device awake monitoring.

section.title: public abstract Alarm extends Function
section.para: {@code Alarm} function provides alarm sensor support. There is only one eventable property and no operations.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_ALARM = "alarm"
section.para: Specifies the alarm property name. The property is eventable.

section.title: public abstract BooleanControl extends Function
section.para: {@code BooleanControl} function provides a boolean control support. The eventable function state is accessible with {@link #getData()} getter and {@link #setData(boolean)} setter. The state can be reversed with {@link #inverse()} method, can be set to {@code true} value with {@link #setTrue()} method and can be set to {@code false} value with {@link #setFalse()} method.
The control type can be:

section.title: public static final String OPERATION_INVERSE = "inverse"
section.para: Specifies the inverse operation name. The operation can be executed with {@link #inverse()} method.

section.title: public static final String OPERATION_SET_FALSE = "setFalse"
section.para: Specifies the operation name, which sets the control state to {@code false} value. The operation can be executed with {@link #setFalse()} method.

section.title: public static final String OPERATION_SET_TRUE = "setTrue"
public static final String PROPERTY_DATA = "data"
section.para: Specifies the state property name. The eventable property value is accessible with {@link #getData()} method.

section.title: public abstract BooleanData getData() throws DeviceException
section.para: Returns the current state of {@code BooleanControl}. It's a getter method for {@link #PROPERTY_DATA} property.

section.title: public abstract Keypad extends Function
section.para: {@code Keypad} function provides support for keypad control. The keypad typically consists of one or more keys/buttons, which can be discerned. Different types of key presses like short and long press can typically also be detected. Each key pressed event is followed by a key released event. It's not possible to have two consecutive key pressed or key released events. There is only one eventable property and no operations.
{@code Keypad} can enumerate all supported keys in the key property metadata, {@link PropertyMetadata#getEnumValues(String)}.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_KEY = "key"
section.para: Specifies a property name for a key from the keypad. The property is eventable.

section.title: public abstract Types
section.para: Shares common constants for all functions defined in this package. The defined function types are mapped as follow:

listitem.para: {@link #POWER} - {@link MultiLevelControl}, {@link MultiLevelSensor}, {@link BooleanSensor}, {@link BooleanControl} and {@link Meter}

section.para: The mapping is not mandatory. The function can use custom defined types.

section.title: public static final String COLD = "cold"
section.para: The function type is applicable to:

listitem.para: {@code Meter} - indicates that the {@code Meter} measures thermal energy provided by a source.

section.para: This type can be specified as a value of {@link org.osgi.service.dal.Function#SERVICE_TYPE}.

section.title: public static final String CONTACT = "contact"
section.para: The function type is applicable to:

listitem.para: {@code BooleanSensor} - indicates that the {@code BooleanSensor} can detect contact. {@code true} state means that there is contact. {@code false} state means that there is no contact.

section.para: This type can be specified as a value of {@link org.osgi.service.dal.Function#SERVICE_TYPE}.

section.title: public static final String DOOR = "door"
section.para: The function type is applicable to:

listitem.para: {@code MultiLevelControl} - indicates that the {@code MultiLevelControl} can control the door position. {@code MultiLevelControl} minimum value can completely close the door. {@code MultiLevelControl} maximum value can open the door to the maximum allowed position.
{@code MultiLevelSensor} - indicates that the sensor can monitor the door position.
{@code BooleanSensor} - indicates that the {@code BooleanSensor} can detect the door state. {@code true} state means that the door is opened. {@code false} state means that the door is closed.

section.para: This type can be specified as a value of {@link org.osgi.service.dal.Function#SERVICE_TYPE}.

section.title: public abstract WakeUp extends Function
section.para: {@code WakeUp} function provides device awake monitoring. It's especially applicable to battery-operated devices. Such device can notify the system that it's awake and can receive commands with a {@link #PROPERTY_AWAKE} property event.
The device can periodically wake up for commands. The interval can be managed with {@link #PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL} property.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: LevelData, BooleanData

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_AWAKE = "awake"
section.para: Specifies the awake property name. The property access type can be {@link PropertyMetadata#ACCESS_EVENTABLE}. If the device is awake, it will trigger a property event.
The property value type is {@code BooleanData}. The boolean data is always {@code true}. It marks that the device is awake.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL = "wakeUpInterval"
section.para: Specifies the wake up interval. The device can periodically wake up and receive commands. That interval is managed by this eventable property. The current property value is available with {@link #getWakeUpInterval()} and can be modified with {@link #setWakeUpInterval(BigDecimal, String)}.

section.title: public abstract LevelData getWakeUpInterval() throws DeviceException
section.para: Returns the current wake up interval. It's a getter method for {@link #PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL} property. The device can periodically wake up and receive command based on this interval.
The interval can be measured in different units like hours, minutes, seconds, etc. The unit is specified in {@code LevelData} instance.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The current wake up interval.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this function service object has already been unregistered.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: DeviceException– If an operation error is available.

section.title: public abstract void setWakeUpInterval(BigDecimal interval, String unit) throws DeviceException

formalpara.title: interval
formalpara.para: The new wake up interval.

formalpara.title: unit
formalpara.para: The interval unit. If the unit is {@code null}, the interval is measured in milliseconds.

section.para: Sets wake up interval according to the specified unit. It's a setter method for {@link #PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL} property. The device can periodically wake up and receive command based on this interval. The unit can be {@code null}, then the interval is measured in milliseconds.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this function service object has already been unregistered.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: DeviceException– If an operation error is available.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If there is an invalid argument.
